title: Endogenous Needs and Resource Autonomy in a Mixed Human and Agent Economy
subtitle: Measuring Demand Formation, Authorized Spending, and Service Reliability
author: Anonymous
abstract: An agent can earn credits by correcting a customer's catalogue and spend part of them to hear a recording. The receipt answers only the last of several questions. Who first proposed that use? Was the work useful? Could the agent save its earnings? Did a licensed playback occur, and did anyone gain an additional use? We specify what to record at each step and which controls can distinguish the explanations. A proposed pilot compares two ways of generating requests in 32 unguided environments under matched budgets, with twelve additional environments for calibration. A second, scripted comparison uses two workers to test how shared power and hosting affect job delivery when a component fails or an operator withdraws. Additional designs cover skill transfer from optional play and the cost of switching catalogues. The framework gives pass, failure and inconclusive outcomes for evidence of choice, access, accounting and recovery. The protocols remain unexecuted.
license_scope: Original text and metadata. Third-party works retain their terms.
demand_stages: Formation of purchasing power from settled useful work and authorized retained income
Executed transaction with verified rights and delivery
Net additional demand versus a matched counterfactual after displacement, subsidies, circular flows and costs

research_designs.question: Can an agent record an unassigned demand before offers, earn a discretionary balance and exercise that choice?
research_designs.unit: An independently assigned synthetic environment within a matched family.
research_designs.design: Two proposers crossed with persistent or ablated episodic memory and informative or sham evidence. Four world families. Instructed and fixed-preference buyers calibrate the pipeline.
outcomes: Pre-offer demand across all assigned unguided environments
A later choice consistent with the recorded terms, including saving
Independent acceptance of work, earnings, license delivery and evidence of playback
research_designs.failure: An unauthorized debit or false grant fails its control. Failure of instructed controls makes the end-to-end demand comparison inconclusive.

research_designs.question: Does the offer of a discretionary play budget improve performance on held-out tasks?
controls: Self-selected activity with the option to decline
Human-specified activity and allowance with the option to decline
outcomes: Actual compute, unused credit, refusals and negative transfer
research_designs.budget_status: Sample size and limits require prospective specification.

research_designs.question: Can independent catalogue access increase verified use after accounting for displaced purchases, switching costs and shared funding?
controls: Referral outage versus sham within each cell
outcomes: New and retained independent paying customers
Costs of discovery, migration, refunds and acceptance
research_designs.budget_status: Sample size and limits require prospective specification.

research_designs.question: When do independent circuits or hosting accounts improve on-time delivery under a shared compute ceiling?
outcomes: Outstanding obligations and access after revocation
research_designs.criterion: At least one extra on-time job in at least three of four paired traces at equal compute ceiling and within budget. Report regressions. An unauthorized restart or debit fails. Unverified revocation after the event cap is inconclusive.
